description: This file defines a report parser class for generating an inverted analytic balance report in Odoo (OpenERP), including methods for data retrieval and calculations related to analytic accounts and lines.

classes.name: account_inverted_analytic_balance
classes.description: A report parser class for generating inverted analytic balance reports in Odoo.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the report parser and sets up local context with helper methods and modules.

methods.name: _lines_g
methods.description: Retrieves analytic line data grouped by general accounts within a date range, calculating debit and credit based on balances.

methods.name: _lines_a
methods.description: Retrieves analytic line data for specific accounts and a general account, including account names and balances.

methods.name: _sum_debit
methods.description: Calculates total debit amounts for given accounts within a date range.

methods.name: _sum_credit
methods.description: Calculates total credit amounts for given accounts within a date range.

methods.name: _sum_balance
methods.description: Calculates the net balance (debit minus credit) for given accounts within a date range.

methods.name: _sum_quantity
methods.description: Calculates total quantity (unit amounts) for given accounts within a date range.
